column1: # The Atlas Unlocked: place names (Crossword.Core.Lexicon.Dictionaries), hand-written for this game.
# Line format: WORD<TAB>description. '#' comments and blank lines are ignored.
# Rules (tests enforce the first three): A-Z only, 3-15 letters; no word already in ENABLE (it would add nothing:
# NICE, CHINA, TURKEY...); every entry has a description. Content: countries, capitals and cities, states and
# provinces, regions, islands, seas, rivers, lakes, mountains and ancient sites; single-word names only, accents
# dropped, 7 letters at most (the board is 7x7, so longer names could never be played). Contested places get a
# geographic description. Entries still go through the denylist.
